content_metadata.description: This video tutorial provides insights and step-by-step instructions on how to effectively use Adobe Premiere Pro Essential Graphics. Viewers will learn how to install necessary tools, use title templates, customize them, and enhance their video editing skills.

qAndA.answer: The name of the folder is 'PC - WEDDING'.
qAndA.question: What is the name of the folder that needs to be copied to the Essential Graphics folder?

qAndA.answer: You need to go to the 'View' menu option and click on 'Hidden items'.
qAndA.question: What menu option should you go to in order to see hidden items in file explorer?

qAndA.answer: Right click on the title template in the timeline, select 'Unlink', and then delete the sound track.
qAndA.question: How do you remove the default sound from the title template?

qAndA.answer: Under the 'Edit' tab in Essential Graphics, click on the color box next to the text element you want to change and select the desired color.
qAndA.question: How do you change the text color in the title template?

qAndA.answer: You can also change the color of the shapes used in the title template.
qAndA.question: Besides text, what other element can you change the color of in the title template?
